messages:
lee_runtime: FYI eu canary preflight failed for runtime-kernel v5.1.2. deploybot aborted with mismatch between uploaded manifest and artifact list.

deploy-bot: :warning: preflight abort: artifact runtime-kernel-v5.1.2 (build 20260317-#410) mismatch: manifest lists files not present in storage listing. aborting.

sam_ops: can we pin eu to v5.1.0 until packaging fixes the publish? short TTL please.

lee_runtime: yes pin. don't want partial bundles hitting canary. recommend 4h TTL.

sam_ops: @deploy-bot pin-image region=eu image=runtime-kernel-v5.1.0 reason="incomplete publish abort" ttl=4h

deploy-bot: ack  pin created: eu -> runtime-kernel-v5.1.0 (ttl 4h). auto-unpin at 6793014834.

nora_pack: packaging triage: the archiver split step failed to finalize a multipart upload for one shard. re-finalizing now and re-listing objects. will re-publish manifest after. ETA 12m.

ops_oncall: checklist before unpin: 1) storage listing contains all files from manifest 2) sha256s for every file match CI 3) smoke run (10m) 4) quick perf run (5m). post outputs.

lee_runtime: if packaging needs more time, extend TTL past maintenance window at 02:00 local.

sam_ops: extending: @deploy-bot extend-pin eu until 6793030000 reason="cover maintenance + publish fix"

deploy-bot: ack  pin extended: eu -> runtime-kernel-v5.1.0 until 6793030000.

maria_docs: adding bullet to internal notes: "eu canary paused for v5.1.2 due to incomplete publish; pinned to v5.1.0." will note packaging follow-up.

nora_pack: re-finalized multipart upload and re-published manifest. storage listing now matches manifest. uploaded checksums: abc1..., bcd2..., cde3...

ops_oncall: verifying checksums now. `sha256sum` matches CI for all files. starting smoke.

ops_oncall: smoke exit 0. sample: `200/200, p95=120ms, mem=5.6GB`. perf quick run nominal.

lee_runtime: good. unpin and staged canary 10% for 20m. rollback criteria: p99 >1.8x or errors >0.8% absolute.

sam_ops: @deploy-bot unpin eu reason="artifact verified, staged canary"

deploy-bot: unpin acknowledged. staged canary: 10% -> runtime-kernel-v5.1.2 in eu for 20m. will post metrics at +10m.

maria_docs: updated release notes and added a packaging checklist item to detect multipart finalization failures.

lee_runtime: monitoring. will call rollback if any aborts or if metrics breach.
